profile_text.body:
Zhipu AI is a Chinese artificial intelligence company operating under the brand Z.ai, with a stated mission of inspiring artificial general intelligence to benefit humanity. The company develops foundation models and AI-powered applications, and describes its work as spanning both cloud and on-device deployment through what it calls an integrated edge-cloud model product matrix.

The company's primary tracked product is the GLM family of Chinese foundation models, marketed internationally under the Z.AI label, for which cross-border data review is advised. Zhipu AI has also released AutoClaw, described as the first one-click locally installable OpenClaw client in China, featuring more than 50 built-in skills and integration with AutoGLM browser operation capabilities. Additional products include Zhipu Qingyan, an on-device conversational application, and CodeGeeX, an AI programming assistant, both of which have been developed in AIPC versions in collaboration with Intel. Zhipu AI Vice President Wu Weijie represented the company at Intel's AI PC Ecosystem Conference, where the Intel-Zhipu partnership on AI PC applications was presented.

No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this company.
